nodes.name: Leadsy Event Webhook
nodes.notes: Single Leadsy entrypoint. Send { workflowKey, tenantId, ownerId, idempotencyKey, payload } to route automation events.

nodes.name: Follow-up Due Schedule
nodes.notes: Follow-up Due Schedule feeds the same router canvas as external Leadsy events.

nodes.name: Worker Retry Schedule
nodes.notes: Worker Retry Schedule feeds the same router canvas as external Leadsy events.

nodes.name: Normalize Webhook Event
nodes.notes: Normalizes event payloads emitted by Leadsy APIs.

nodes.name: Normalize Follow-up Due
nodes.notes: n8n scheduled due check or task due timestamp.

nodes.name: Normalize Worker Retry
nodes.notes: Worker task failed, blocked, postponed, or reached retry due time.

nodes.name: Validate Event
nodes.notes: Validates the workflowKey and computes the Leadsy API path. No visual branch per event type.

nodes.name: Provider Config Check
nodes.notes: Reads Meta, WhatsApp, Email, and OpenRouter provider configuration from the n8n service environment. It reports only configured/missing status to Leadsy, never secret values.

providerConfigs.label: Meta
providerConfigs.purpose: Provider credentials for automation calls against Meta Graph APIs after Leadsy stores the event.
providerConfigs.leadsyBoundary: Leadsy keeps Meta OAuth, webhook verification, tenant routing, and stored communications.

fields.label: App ID
fields.purpose: Identifies the Meta app used by automation calls.

fields.label: App secret
fields.purpose: Signs and validates Meta app-level automation requests.

fields.label: Graph API version
fields.purpose: Pins Graph API calls made by n8n provider steps.

fields.label: Lead Ads page access token
fields.purpose: Lets n8n enrich stored Meta Lead Ads records when needed.

providerConfigs.label: WhatsApp
providerConfigs.purpose: Provider credentials for approved WhatsApp follow-up and reply automation.
providerConfigs.leadsyBoundary: Leadsy keeps inbound WhatsApp webhook handling, storage, qualification state, and approvals.

fields.label: Business API token
fields.purpose: Authorizes n8n to call the WhatsApp Business Cloud API after approval.

fields.label: Phone number ID
fields.purpose: Selects the sending phone number for approved WhatsApp actions.

fields.label: Send mode
fields.purpose: Keeps automation in approval-only mode until outbound sends are intentionally enabled.

providerConfigs.label: Email
providerConfigs.purpose: Provider credentials for outbound email notifications, alerts, and approved outreach.
providerConfigs.leadsyBoundary: Leadsy keeps communication records, approvals, and audit history.

fields.label: Email provider
fields.purpose: Selects smtp, resend, or postmark in n8n branches.

fields.label: SMTP host
fields.purpose: SMTP host when n8n uses direct SMTP.

fields.label: SMTP user
fields.purpose: SMTP username for n8n email sends.

fields.label: SMTP password
fields.purpose: SMTP password for n8n email sends.

fields.label: Resend API key
fields.purpose: Alternative Resend credential for n8n email sends.

fields.label: Postmark server token
fields.purpose: Alternative Postmark credential for n8n email sends.

providerConfigs.label: OpenRouter
providerConfigs.purpose: Provider credentials and model routing for automation research, qualification, summaries, and drafts.
providerConfigs.leadsyBoundary: Leadsy keeps AI approvals, saved outputs, cost records, and deterministic fallbacks.

fields.label: API key
fields.purpose: Authorizes n8n automation steps that call OpenRouter.

fields.label: Base URL
fields.purpose: Overrides the default OpenRouter API base URL.

fields.label: Fast model
fields.purpose: Low-latency model for routine routing and summaries.

fields.label: Research model
fields.purpose: Research model for lead intelligence jobs.

fields.label: Sentiment model
fields.purpose: Model for conversation sentiment and intent analysis.

meta.purpose: Route every Leadsy automation event through one configurable n8n workflow.
meta.preserves: n8n owns automation provider config; Leadsy remains the application backend, auth/RBAC boundary, and Postgres source of truth.

routes.name: Lead Added
routes.purpose: Start qualification, summary, and task orchestration after Leadsy owns the lead record.
routes.trigger: Leadsy stores a new lead from manual intake, Meta, WhatsApp, or extension sync.
routes.preserves: Lead CRUD and lead storage stay in Leadsy.

routes.name: Lead Updated
routes.purpose: Refresh only the intelligence artifacts affected by the changed fields.
routes.trigger: Leadsy updates contact, status, task, knowledge, or communication fields.
routes.preserves: Lead updates and tenant checks stay in Leadsy APIs.

routes.name: Research Requested
routes.purpose: Coordinate research while keeping evidence, spend, and saved records inside Leadsy.
routes.trigger: Operator or schedule asks Leadsy to research a lead or research request.
routes.preserves: OpenRouter automation config lives in n8n while saved outputs and cost state stay in Leadsy.

routes.name: Qualification Requested
routes.purpose: Score fit/urgency and decide whether task or approval routing is needed.
routes.trigger: Lead added, lead updated, WhatsApp message received, or operator request.
routes.preserves: Qualification result storage stays in Leadsy.

routes.name: Task Generated
routes.purpose: Route approvals, due reminders, and retry schedules around Leadsy task state.
routes.trigger: Leadsy creates an extension, CRM, or follow-up task.
routes.preserves: Task CRUD and status transitions stay in Leadsy.

routes.name: Approval Requested
routes.purpose: Create a central approval item and pause downstream automation until reviewed.
routes.trigger: Research, task, note, draft, outreach, or qualification output requires human review.
routes.preserves: Leadsy remains the human approval gate before outbound sends.

routes.name: Follow-up Due
routes.purpose: Surface due follow-ups and create approved draft paths when useful.
routes.trigger: n8n scheduled due check or task due timestamp.
routes.preserves: Follow-up task state stays in Leadsy.

routes.name: Meta Lead Received
routes.purpose: Run post-storage qualification and approval routing for Meta-originated leads.
routes.trigger: Existing Leadsy Meta route stores a Meta-derived lead or communication.
routes.preserves: Public Meta webhooks continue to terminate at Leadsy.

routes.name: WhatsApp Message Received
routes.purpose: Generate reply suggestions, refresh qualification, and route approvals.
routes.trigger: Existing Leadsy WhatsApp/Meta route stores an inbound WhatsApp message.
routes.preserves: WhatsApp message handling and storage stay in Leadsy.

routes.name: Worker Retry
routes.purpose: Retry only safe worker actions and escalate exhausted/non-retryable failures.
routes.trigger: Worker task failed, blocked, postponed, or reached retry due time.
routes.preserves: Leadsy keeps worker task state while the extension remains the capture/execution layer.
